map.胸径和地径怎么测？: How are diameter at breast height and ground diameter measured?
map.胸径量离地 1.3m 处主干直径；地径量根茎交接处。裸根苗常测地径，带土球大苗常: Diameter at breast height is the trunk diameter 1.3 m above ground; ground diameter is measured at the root-stem junction. Bare-root seedlings usually use ground diameter, while large balled trees use breast height diameter, subject to the design.
